Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_0
Text: The name's Alton. I'm Foreman here at Dawnbreak Harbor.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_22
Text: Let me extend a most warm and friendly welcome to Dawnbreak City! Please, step into the Immigration Office in a nice and orderly manner, and claim your citizenship!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_2
Text: Dawnbreak Isle. What a godforsaken pissbowl this place is. Make no mistake, you're as stuck here as we are.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_53
Text: Hey honey. See anything pretty? Want to buy yourself something pretty?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_54
Text: Ogoun guide ya blade, but Marinette takes ya soul, if ya cross us.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_55
Text: Whoosh... Give me a moment. Need to catch my breath. The ol' body ain't used to this much exercise.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_57
Text: Soon, we are out of business, and that'll be the end of us Dockers. Many of us have already ditched us and made a devil's deal with the Mad Dogs. I consider that a personal affront - you don't sell out your brothers just because your wallet is a little light.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_52
Text: Aaah, don't come closer, mon! Keep aways, or I'll have Marinette torment ya!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_68
Text: Don't you dare come any closer. I can pop your head with this gun miles away.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_73
Text: If youse ain't lookin' ta buy sumpin', buzz off, bub.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_76
Text: Man, that Labycore... I hope you give them what's coming.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_64
Text: Man, I need a break from all this. Maybe a weekend in a spa, with someone strong and handsome. And with cherries. Definitely cherries. And a pina colada. Or a mojito.\nHmm. Choices, choices...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_63
Text: Touch my gun and I will end you.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_62
Text: Labycore is running the power plants in the west end of the industrial area. And Mad Dogs control the north end... They have turned the place into a big drug factory, and use some of the drilling equipment to make more drugs.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_56
Text: We must keep this place clean from those Hired Guns thugs.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_78
Text: Holy crap. Is this dump supposed to be the glorious Dawnbreak City? They said that we need to get registered, so that we can enter the city.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_84
Text: \qWelcome to city of your dreams\q, they said. Ha. What a joke. And the joke's on us.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_87
Text: No time to chitchat. It's payday! I'm gonna paint the town red, and party like it's 2099!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_97
Text: Me and the rest of the Valkyries can and will kick your ass if you do business with Labycore. Maybe you think we ain't much, but we sure are mean. You don't want to make me illustrate that point.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_98
Text: Tonight is a day just like last week.\nNo, wait... That doesn't make sense, does it?\n*giggles*

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_100
Text: The girls offer a wide selection of services for a wide selection of appetites. Whatever you desire, hon, they can make it happen.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_101
Text: Is there something you want? Coffee? Tea? Me? Or just something to... eat?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_102
Text: Hakuna matata, friend. Let them others worry about worldly problems. Sit with me a while, and let me teach you about zen and the art of engine maintenance.\nBelieve me, Zen Buddhism and personal equilibrium is the way to go.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_104
Text: Hey there! Another day, another dollar eh?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_112
Text: Ye're propably looking for Walter? He's near that big warehouse over yonder.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_121
Text: Let's beat those mofos into a pulp.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_122
Text: Want a taste, do you? I'll make you a deal - get past this blade here in one piece, and you get a free sample. C'mon now, don't be shy.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_6
Text: ( Eric is too exhausted to talk. )

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_1
Text: I used to be a general goods vendor before I lost my license. Sad story eh?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_128
Text: You should not go there. It's a dangerous place.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_127
Text: Move it. Get in to the van. We do not tolerate friendly fire!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_129
Text: Go make this city a better place for normal people like us. Or if you ain't got the cojones for big things like that, how about gettin' me a cup of joe?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_130
Text: This used to be a much better place. Now the Hooligans and Mad Dogs run most of this territory, and us decent folk will be out of space soon.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_137
Text: Move along, citizen, or you may be fined for loitering. Thank you. Have a pleasant day.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_92
Text: What do you want? I got nothing for you, you hear?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_83
Text: I have no time for idle chitchat.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_143
Text: Serve the public trust.\nProtect the innocent.\nUphold the law.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_58
Text: You should be on your guard at all times when roaming these parts of the island. Drill Facility and Power Plant can be found just up the road, but you shouldn't go there without a reason.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_59
Text: Have you visited Abyssos Warehouses or Abyssos Marketplace yet? They might have some work for you as well.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_91
Text: How do you like the industrial area of the island? I hate doing trips to our other camps because the damn Hooligans are lurking around every corner.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_89
Text: Now that the Abyssos Project's drilling facilities are inactive, Mad Dogs have turned the place into a huge W.U.Z.Z factory. I wish we could somehow stop the Mad Dogs. Dawnbreak would be a lot safer place then...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_90
Text: Hey. Eyes up here, unless you're paying up front.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_105
Text: Wherever W.U.Z.Z. enters the picture, sorrow and misery will soon follow...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_103
Text: I'm in charge of the bridge.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_147
Text: Oh my gosh. This 'Kill Cluster 3000' weapon is so cool.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_148
Text: For Christ's sake! How can the stevedores expect us to do our work when they can't even load a truck so that nothing falls out in midtransit?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_149
Text: Just waiting for the taxi or my friends to come and pick me up. Either's good, but just standing here pisses me off. There's so much cool stuff to do, and waiting sure isn't on the list!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_152
Text: Leave me alone. I don't know you.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_151
Text: Some of the Dockers here help the Resistance out when they can. I try to help them out in return, while keeping an eye out for people who want to do more than just unload crates. You look like you're one of those people.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_3
Text: The name's Donovan. Not sure I know you though?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_167
Text: Nothin' to do, just waiting for a call. Could be worse, I guess.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_175
Text: May excessive force be with you.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_114
Text: Ssh, keep it quiet! I'm undercover... Checking cargo.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_176
Text: Lost all my savings to MMO subscriptions... Why oh why didn't I just stick with free to play browser games?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_177
Text: Labycore plays tricks with our minds. Y'see, this is all an illusion. All matter is merely energy condensed to a slow vibration... We are all one consciousness experiencing itself subjectively. There's no such thing as death, life is only a dream, and we're the imagination of ourselves.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_179
Text: Spare some change? For food, honest!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_180
Text: Don't bother me now. Following some leads.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_181
Text: Man, how can 24 hours per day be enough for anyone? There's simply too much to see, too much to do, too much to know!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_183
Text: We will rock your bones apart!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_93
Text: We Docker rules this part of the city, and you'd do wise to remember that.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_115
Text: No matter how much I want to, I can't spank all of the Queens on my own. It's good to have you for backup.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_154
Text: Sorry, but I'm out of the business. You have to look for your fun somewhere else.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_194
Text: I used to have my own dojo... they took it all away. Darn class action suit!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_193
Text: Hired Guns trashed my shop.... I'll show 'em...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_80
Text: What is this place?! I'm going to wait for Emily to arrive. I'm sure they will send her downstairs too.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_86
Text: I'm so desperate! Did I say desperate? I mean eager to work, sir! Anything you have in mind! And I do mean anything.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_108
Text: My ass is stuck in here, watching after these people with Xavier... I don't mind helping, as such. It's just that I want in on the real action, you know? Spilling some Hooligan blood and making them scream for mommy. Ah, that'd make my day!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_195
Text: Patrolling the area and making sure that Mad Dogs or Hooligans or even Labycore do not attack. If that's not an important job, I don't know what is.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_159
Text: I'm gonna go get some hot tamales.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_201
Text: Have you seen what the Hoolies have done to one of our babies outside the shop? It's totally useless now!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_200
Text: Welcome to Rudehoods! We tune up and provide more armor to vehicles! Even Labycore can't match our products!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_205
Text: Big is beautiful, that's what my mama always told me!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_204
Text: I like to plink at cargo ships passing by. That doesn't make me a bad person, right?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_202
Text: I got weapons. I like weapons. Especially blades.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_208
Text: Beat me all you want! I'll never tell!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_197
Text: I like the Turtles. Especially Leonardo. He's so, like, oh, wow. Zing. You know?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_214
Text: These babies know how to handle the enemy.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_215
Text: Be respectful to Mr. Roman, or Mr. Roman will knock your head right off. That's a fact.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_216
Text: Those freaking Eastern Queens. Shakin' that skanky ass and flashing a poxy smile, all so you earn enough for your next fix. I pity them. I really do.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_217
Text: Flat rates. 300 for hour, and I'll take you to cloud nine in any way you most desire.\nFor 400, you can bring a friend.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_218
Text: Wait, what? What the hell happened? I just woke up and I can't remem--- Hey... WHERE THE HELL ARE MY PANTS?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_20
Text: Go away, I can't hear what those Queens are saying with you tryin' to chat me up.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_19
Text: See anything you like? Bet you do. Bet you have something you'd like in mind, too. Something special. Well, you came to the right girl.\nOne thing, though. The safe word's 'Orange'. When I say 'orange', you stop. No matter what you were doing, you stop. That's the safe word, and if I use it, it means you need to back off a bit. Okay?\nGood. Still interested?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_5
Text: I'd rather go back to my old job loading bananas.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_222
Text: Oh, sorry, didn't see you there.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_7
Text: I have a special arrangement with the guards. They only hassle me on Wednesdays!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_21
Text: Welcome to the Tropical Paradise! Right?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_227
Text: Need some guiding, sugar? Like what to put where? All these sliding parts, they can be hard to grasp.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_228
Text: That basketball court has turned into a bloodsport arena...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_226
Text: I'm busy at the moment, but if you like what you see, I get off duty in an hour. Rates are not negotiable.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_24
Text: Our friend had to go downstairs. I hope everything goes smoothly. And why shouldn't it? I'm sure you both get the citizenship in no time.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_25
Text: In you go, citizen candidate! A glorious future awaits!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_26
Text: I'm here to see how many poor souls enter the island daily without a clue on what's really happening behind the scenes. You are one of the rare indivuals who have escaped from Labycore interrogators. Consider yourself lucky.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_27
Text: Hel... Help me! Get me out of here!\nWhen I get back home, I'll let everyone know that these crazy maniacs waterboard innocent people here! I didn't do nuthin'!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_28
Text: Labycore is the reflection of its creator Sid Lovens. Make no mistake. That man is evil to the core.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_29
Text: We sold our entire property to start a new life. We are so excited to finally be here!\nGod bless Sid Lovens and Labycore for this opportunity!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_30
Text: Quite a ride, huh? Too bad there isn't any other way to get on this magnificent isle than those uncomfortable cargo ships... Why is the isle under trade blockade anyway?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_31
Text: How is the world outside Dawnbreak City?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_32
Text: It will take blood, and it will take tears, but eventually Labycore will fall, and we will bring peace and justice to Dawnbreak Isle. Feels good to fight for a noble cause like this.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_34
Text: The Resistance is a field organization of island-wide resistance movement against Labycore and its' allies.\nSome of the local gangs are on our side, but most gangs work for Labycore in one way or another.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_35
Text: A proper warrior scoffs at firearms! Anyone can be brave from far away! It takes true skill and true grit to deal with problems in hand to hand combat. Have you got what it takes, kid?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_36
Text: Dressing up like homeless junkies makes us invisible to Labycore. They couldn't care less about homeless. You should do well to remember that.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_38
Text: I'm here to build various programs and tools for our Freedom Fighters.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_39
Text: Let me give you a free tip: The more friends you bring with you from the outside world to Dawnbreak City, the more credible you are.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_40
Text: Before coming to Dawnbreak I was a real knight. I was ennobled by the Queen herself. Here... Well. Here they don't appreciate knights as much. Chivalry is dead here. Makes me wish I was dead, too.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_41
Text: I've run out of things to sell.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_42
Text: I can feel the gears of war turning...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_231
Text: Faster! Harder! Scooter!\nI'm kidding! I'm kidding! I surrender!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_235
Text: These streets are wild! I love it!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_43
Text: This Old Town hospital is one of the safest places here.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_44
Text: Pretty Roger is the best mercenary around...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_45
Text: Always ready to help a friend in need! As long as you got the cash.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_184
Text: You called. Me and my boom shotty Hemingway answered. Get it? Hemingway? Because he blew his head off with a shotgun! Hahaha! Get it?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_185
Text: Watch out. It's sharp. Want me to illustrate my point?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_186
Text: I named my bat Daisy. Daisy here has been dancing on many faces. See this hole here? That's where she broke her first tooth.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_239
Text: .32 caliber is my favorite. It might be small, it might be light, but there's so little recoil! When I go pop-pop-pop, I can write my name on your ass.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_241
Text: Don't come any closer, or I'll let her rip.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_245
Text: You don't know me. And you never will. Let's just get this party going.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_248
Text: You called to the Alpha male. Better not be for nothin'.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_255
Text: I just got my shovel pimped up.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_250
Text: I'll protect the one who pays me. Simple as that.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_249
Text: Yea the coat is a bit too small but hey... See my muscles and my saw?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_169
Text: Goddamn Labycore. Screw them, and the horse they rode in on!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_191
Text: Clean this crap right out, boom.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_229
Text: I used to be a model, you know. People liked my body, and my clothes. Do you like my outfit? See how it clings to my body?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_242
Text: We have been locked here, outside the city walls by Labycore. They have abandoned us.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_243
Text: I will kill for you.\nHell, I'd kill just for the thrill of it.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_246
Text: Ever seen a man go down from a shot to the balls? It's hilarious!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_247
Text: Don't screw with me. I can hit you in the eye with this.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_252
Text: My second name? You might think it, but I didn't get it for this gun here, know what I mean, hehheh?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_256
Text: Yeah... I got my nickname from chicken. What of it?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_258
Text: You'd better not make me mad. I can shoot you from Stuttgart and make it look like a suicide.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_261
Text: Hi!\nClick on the green arrow in front of the door to enter the Immigration Offices.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_262
Text: Remember to use your crafted weapon boosters to maximize your damage.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_263
Text: When you are in a tight spot, hire a mercenary to help you out.\nEither buy services from hardcore local mercenaries, or hire one of your friends to help you.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_264
Text: There are two area types in the game: meeting areas, and adventure areas.\nYou just entered a meeting area! Here you can mingle with other online players and form groups to adventure together around Dawnbreak City.\nAdventure areas can be faced alone or in a group. You can create a group of your own, or join an existing one. You can also leave at any time.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_266
Text: To equip your newly crafted or bought items, open your bag and start using them.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_267
Text: Labycore wants to silence us. They have blocked us out of the city on purpose.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_268
Text:
Rare and uncommon items are much more powerful than poor and common items, so keep an eye out for these!
You can tell an item's rarity by looking at the color of the item's name.
Gray: Poor. Sell these, unless you absolutely have nothing else to use.
White: Common. Nothing special, but could be good, if nothing else was available.
Green: Uncommon. An above average item with great performance.
Blue: Rare. These babies are worth it every time.
Violet: Epic. These rarest of the rare are the best items you can find.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_269
Text: For difficult missions you probably need help from your friends. The easiest way to get their help is to invite them to your group.\n1) Click 'F' for Friends menu, then click a friend's name on the list and select 'Invite to Group'.\n2) Click the player you want to invite with your mouse cursor, then click their character card on the left, and select 'Invite to Group'.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_270
Text: BOSS FIGHT!\nThere's a boss inside the building, on the second floor. Bosses are very difficult, and can usually be defeated only with a group of friends.\nBosses drop more items than ordinary enemies. They also have a higher probability to drop UNCOMMON and RARE items, so killing a boss has a good chance of making you much more powerful!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_271
Text: To see your mission log and where the mission target is, view the World Map.\nPress 'M' to open the map, or click the Map icon next to the minimap in the upper right corner.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_273
Text: In meeting areas or in a group, you can Inspect what items the other player has. Click the player character, then click the symbol next to the character thumbnail on the top center of the screen.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_272
Text: When you have two weapons equipped, use the space bar to switch between a ranged weapon and a melee weapon.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_274
Text: To add or view friends in the game, press 'F' to see the Friends menu.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_275
Text: To invite friends, send beta keys from the bottom right menu bar. The number of people you can invite right now is limited, but you get more invites every time you reach a new experience level.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_276
Text: To see which of your friends are online, look at the center of the bottom Friends menu bar. Click your friends' thumbnails to invite them to Gunshine.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_277
Text: Hope zombies don't think I'm big...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_278
Text: Use taxi to fast travel by clicking a taxi stand. You can only travel to locations that you have already visited. When you log back in Gunshine, you will enter Dawnbreak Isle next to the taxi stand that's closest to the point where you last logged out.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_285
Text: Goddamn Labycore turdmonkeys. Get off my property!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_292
Text: Well? Don't just stand there! Go do something useful, you hear? Go on, now! Get going!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_305
Text: Welcome to war, soldier. Lock 'n' load. You need to be tougher and more skilled to get to islands.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_293
Text: I'm not very interested in embroidery, only in results.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_294
Text: Ready for action, soldier? You'd better be! This war was NOT started for your private gratification, and you can be damned sure it's not being run for your personal convenience, either!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_295
Text: Killin' Labycore generals could get to be a habit with me.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_296
Text: I'm known for my keen eye for detail, so trust me when I say the plan's good to go.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_297
Text: (Jefferson glares at you)\nYou look like you have a question about the dining arrangements. We can discuss place settings right away, or you can GET TO WORK.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_298
Text: Load up, soldier. Plenty of bad guys to kill.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_299
Text: All right, let's have the basic outline...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_300
Text: All right, let's get this over and done with. I have a date.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_301
Text: Don't worry if the soldiers here act a bit rowdy. You'll be fine. This isn't even close to the most twisted, anti-social bunch of psychopathic deformities I have ever run into.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_303
Text: We're coming for you, Lovens! It's judgment day, sinners!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_304
Text: To tell you the truth, I'd rather be a civilian.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_307
Text: They say I look like Brando's brother.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_309
Text: Labycore said that I could get Pritzker Prize for this.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_310
Text: Look at all these Dogs... so much firepower. It makes you wonder what they're up to.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_311
Text: I was a Navy SEAL back in the day. I know when I'm against tough odds, and this island? This is nothing but tough odds.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_314
Text: Move it, move it, move it! I ain't got all day!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_315
Text: No talking! Follow the yellow line and step thru the gate, or you'll be sorry!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_316
Text: That's right, baby. One day soon, you and I will have ourselves some quality time.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_317
Text: There are two ways out of this 'immigration center'. One is sucking up to the guards and showing a certain lack of morals. These 'lucky ones' are recruited to one of the many gangs of the island, and all of them do Labycore's bidding.\nThe second method is dying.\nThank the Resistance for finding a third way. I can't wait to break out of here!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_318
Text: Time to get out of here! Rock on, rock on, rock on!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_319
Text: It's time to escape this prison. You have your weapon ready?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_321
Text:
Attacking targets is easy. Just click to attack.



Try this at that glass wall below us. Then follow the yellow line to the next room.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_334
Text: Welcome to Dawnbreak Isle's 'Immigration Center'. Shoulda stayed home, eh?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_333
Text: Did you hear? The jailbreak is about to happen! Righteous!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_335
Text: Wait, what? We're finally ready to bust this joint? About time.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_331
Text: Nah, c'mon, it ain't so bad here. Just do what you're told and sleep a lot. I used to pay good money for vacations with fewer relaxation opportunities.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_330
Text: Did they hit you? They hit me. I don't want to be hit again.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_327
Text: The guards will get their act together in a manner of minutes!\n\nPrison's supply road is the only way out. Follow it. You need to keep moving!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_325
Text: Help me! There are zombies everywhere!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_328
Text: Hire mercenaries when you need more firepower.\n\nYou can invite and hire your friends as mercenaries too. Just click \qHire\q on the lower mercenary bar. Friends are cost less to hire, and they earn rewards by helping you.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_326
Text: Maude said you'd be the one we have been expecting. I hope she is right. Now move one before it's too late.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_352
Text: Do you know why I love flying so much? I just love to use all the guns to crush my enemies, see them driven before me, and to hear the lamentation of their women.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_351
Text: Cyril is mean. Cyril says I can't go near Orville. Cyril says I'm too dumb to touch Orville. I am dumb. It's alright, I don't mind. I just like engines. I'm happy when I can play with engines. I wish Cyril would let me play with Orville's engine. Cyril is dumb.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_349
Text: You may find this funny, but I kinda like it here. All my life, I've been searching a purpose, a meaning for my life. Now I got one. I have a cause to fight for. It gives me serenity and inner peace. I know, it sounds crazy, but what can I say?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_353
Text: Man, we really ought to pimp Orville. The engine's already souped up, but we lack Dagmars, zoomie pipes, Appletons on both sides... And a minigun. Definitely a minigun.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_360
Text: See this gun? This could turn Hare Krishna into a Bad Bwoy!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_358
Text: Lady of the evening at your service. Back in the old country, I was a scientist. Here, I put out for a living.\nGuess what? I like this more. A lot more.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_359
Text: Oh, look at you. What a treat you are! Want me to show you how I enjoy treats?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_361
Text: Do you know what 'nemesis' means? A righteous infliction of retribution manifested by an appropriate agent. Personified in this case by me. I'm gonna teach Labycore all this, first hand.\nYeah, I got a score to settle.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_363
Text: Many people hate Labycore, and they hate what the corp does, and they hate that Lovens gets away with it. But when push comes to shove, these same people mutter to themselves, and just walk away. I can't understand that kind of mentality. The world doesn't change just because you want it to change. You have to change it. You. Personally.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_348
Text: You don't know what a few months in jail can do to you. Your brain just... what was I saying?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_356
Text: Even though large tracts of Dawnbreak Isle and many parts of the city has fallen into the grip of Citizen Security and all the odious apparatus of Labycore rule, we shall not flag or fail.\nWe shall go on to the end, we shall fight in the harbor, we shall fight on the seas and oceans, we shall fight with growing confidence and growing strength in the air, we shall defend our Isle, whatever the cost may be, we shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds, we shall fight in the fields and in the streets, we shall fight in the hills.\nWe shall never surrender.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_357
Text: The unknown future rolls toward us. I face it, for the first time, with a sense of hope.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_344
Text: I heard quite a many people got freed from the Immigration Center. That's really good news. Let's just hope that at least some of them want some payback and are willing to join the Resistance.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_365
Text: I'm glad that you decided to come here, and build a better tomorrow with Labycore.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_366
Text: If you already talked to Dante on the pier, be a good citizen candidate and step through the gate.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_368
Text: Do you want to know what I did to end up in isolation? I said 'Labycore sucks, this place sucks, and all you guards can suck my rooster!'\nAfter that, they shot me in the back with two taser darts, and convulsed so hard I soiled myself.\nIt was worth it.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_369
Text: They can't... They can't do this to us! This is against the Geneva convention! We have rights! They have to let us go!\n\n...right?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_367
Text: Oh geez. A guard beat me up. I think I have a concussion. I can't stop throwing up.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_372
Text: Not a very popular place with the brothers.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_371
Text:
We have to plan our next step very carefully. Come back later - now is not the time to act.

You've previously faced Security and gangs, but this... This is a full-fledged Labycore compound. We will most certainly face heavy resistance and well trained enemies. We'll need to think this through.

In the meantime... Simon says 'Bring Simon a glazed donut and a cup of hot coffee. Black, two sugars.'

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_374
Text: Ow... Every step hurts... Why is Labycore doing this to us?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_347
Text: To do this job you gotta be a great actor, you gotta be a natural. You gotta be Brando.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_381
Text: I can't wait to get out of this stinking armor...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_383
Text: I'm sorry, but I can't trust anyone right now.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_386
Text: You learn something new every day, eh?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_387
Text: Life used to be aimless. Then I bought this rifle.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_389
Text: We are in costant need of supplies.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_390
Text: We nhave to scavende our wares from the labycore.. But Not for long I hope.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_396
Text: This isn't the dream vacation they advertised!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_397
Text: What's happening? Let me go, you lunatics!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_398
Text: Where on Earth is this place? I want to go home!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_404
Text: Keep it quiet! There are Labycore patrols everywhere.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_407
Text: I heard Labycore Troopers are lurking around. We must be careful.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_409
Text: This is a horrible place. It makes you wonder - how can people do such a thing? Taking away those innocent girls' freedom, dignity and even life.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_414
Text: Please help me! Can you help me? Please!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_415
Text: I'm so scared... what are they going to do to us?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_412
Text: Help me out from this horrible place!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_280
Text: Hey man. We must talk, but not here. It's top secret! Don't let my brothers in on it!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_419
Text: Making sure that no one gets hurt.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_422
Text: \qI can't get no satisfaction...\q but I can give it to you baby!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_423
Text: Gyrate, rotate, two three sexy! Smile!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_428
Text: I'll stay here and watch your back.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_434
Text: \qThis hologram show is brought to you by Valkyries of Dawnbreak. Visit the Pirate Bay club for more adult entertainment.\q

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_430
Text: Dawnbreak prisons are getting pretty packed as Labycore becomes more and more paranoid about possible traitors.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_432
Text: Urgh... The heat and all the beatings I get are making me dizzy.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_431
Text: Don't let my last name fool you.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_424
Text: I'm trying to get this gate open!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_441
Text: When I get away from here... hijo de puta!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_451
Text: Don't bring a fist to a knife fight.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_452
Text: They call me Dillinger. Yeah, I pulled off a few nice bank heists back in the day.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_472
Text: I'm here with my husband. Isn't he cuddly!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_471
Text: Oh... that Mortimer is so hot.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_482
Text: Me Mr. Bungle. MISTER to you!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_488
Text: Gaah! It's another Spiderbot! Can't you hear the clack of its terrible feet?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_496
Text: I get knocked down... but can't get up again.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_510
Text: No time to talk. We have killing to do.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_493
Text: I'm ready to spill a lot of blood for a drop of water.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_487
Text: > Insert coin, plans and exotic materials

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_486
Text: > Insert coin, plans and raw materials

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_499
Text: The first Cut is the deepest, as they say.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_498
Text: Everybody calls me sharp, but I'm starting think they're just teasing me.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_469
Text: Mort want a wife. Little man help.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_448
Text: [ Samantha is completely focused on her performance ]

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_354
Text: Clubbing, stabbing, smashing, bashing. What'll it be?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_350
Text: Slugs, bullets, buckshot. All that goes down well with gunpowder!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_531
Text: Welcome to Pearl Island! Enjoy the tropical paradise... while the illusion lasts.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_532
Text: Have you heard the hunting party found a strange hatch in the woods?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_533
Text: Damn dragons. They come in during the night to steal our food and chew on our shelters.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_538
Text: When I'm the boss, I'm just going to lie on the beach whole day!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_551
Text: NO TIME TO TALK! KILL THEM!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_555
Text: You must be the new mechanic. Please take that elevator to the basement.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_556
Text: Remember ze mizzion: Ve are hier to take zis place down.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_557
Text: Congratulations <PLAYER_NAME>!\n\nYou found one of the Easter Eggs of Gunshine.net.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_552
Text: We will hold the fort, don't worry.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_560
Text: They said I'd be paid well.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_564
Text: I'm a hunter, not a soldier!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_566
Text: Suddenly my gun just isn't working! What can I say?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_567
Text: They said that this island is a paradise.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_569
Text: I only want some food, and a job and family.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_571
Text: They said I got a job as an intern here.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_573
Text: Wolfe is a bit... eccentric, but her heart is in the right place.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_579
Text: If I lay down, those lizard won't eat me... or was that the bears?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_581
Text: I got this cool weapon with one of those coupons!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_589
Text: You can look, but not touch.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_591
Text: Look, I just work here. Don't hurt me.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_618
Text: I tried to run... but a bot tazed me in the ass!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_619
Text: I hope I don't get sent back!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_621
Text: For information about employment opportunities in Labycore Research Division, please send a message to jobs@eurekaresearch.daw

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_630
Text: I'm trying to figure out the guards' patrol patterns. There must be a stealth meter somewhere!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_629
Text: Welcome to Eureka Research Center! I'm Miss Holorun, the Vice President of Labycore Corporation.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_622
Text: Please enjoy your visit to Eureka, and don't forget to recommend this tour to your fellow citizens!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_623
Text: They gave me something... all I see is red!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_624
Text: I have no idea what's going on. Who are these people?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_625
Text: They did horrible things to us!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_626
Text: No! No more detergent ads, I can't take it!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_627
Text: I'll do anything, just get me out of here!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_628
Text: Don't you understand? We're people! We're not lab animals!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_631
Text: We'll keep searching for missing people... but I fear the worst.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_633
Text: Grim Gonzales has the access chip to the gate.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_632
Text: Save the family. Save the humanity. Frack!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_677
Text: Here, let me patch you up.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_656
Text: I don't even know what's going on here!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_635
Text: Congratulations <PLAYER_NAME>!\n\nYou found one of the Easter Eggs of Gunshine.net. There is no price tough...now go back and play gunshine.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_284
Text: I know my name is... peculiar, but it's better than some people I know. How about that Throatwobbler Mangrove character?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_282
Text: General? Yep, that's my middle name. I prefer to be called J.G.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_283
Text: You might have met my siblings. Truth be told, they're a bit weird so I like to keep my distance.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_281
Text: I'm a brother from another mother. Mr. Goods was my dad.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_364
Text: Sorry, we're still waiting for that supply boat.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_279
Text: Me and my bro Reids are close. Dunno much about that other bunch.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_329
Text: Rooster's the name. I'll let you figure out why they call me that!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_695
Text: Beep-Bop! Hi, my name is Blip!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_697
Text: I'm here to enforce the rules.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_698
Text: I'll be right with you! Just fixing the arena after the last \qFriendly\q.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_699
Text: Two enter, one leave. Law of STORMDOME!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_702
Text: Better get moving, unless you want to get your brain cut up!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_704
Text: We need to work together. Call me any time!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_714
Text: When hunting Bosses you better be prepared.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_722
Text: This room was build by our awesome artist Piksel.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_724
Text: You need a Beta Key of Awesomeness to get to the back room.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_728
Text: I can get you what you need

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_758
Text: Heyyyyy! I can fix all things electonical!

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_765
Text: Thanks for saving me...I think I'm hurt...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_773
Text: I've always wanted to see Venice. You're not a zombie, are you?

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_772
Text: Do you remember how it was before the zombies attacked...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_769
Text: Show some ID? And read our TOS.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_768
Text: Oh, those zombies are so bad for bussiness

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_767
Text: I can make some good drinks....

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_779
Text: We are getting more and more survivors everyday.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_778
Text: Howdy. wach your back in there.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_794
Text: I can get you to the Dawnbreak...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_802
Text: I don't how much that gate holds...

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_808
Text: I have the plans for all the other keys but the beta key of awesomeness.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_819
Text: Yup, I do some fine drawings.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_824
Text: Howdy! What are you buying? Oh, sorry...my goods are stolen...so I won't be selling nothing.

Name: TID_CHARACTER_SMALL_TALK_830
Text: I have no idea what goes on this city anymore.
